read_by: Agent-drafted, from the cell's own tier table, capability, consumer binding and decision log
input: Water depth above station grade (ft) at the facility point, 0 to 10 ft; sub-peril (pluvial, riverine or coastal) must be stated; deeper or missing depth is withheld
out_of_scope: External access road and project support allowances ($3.06M, outside the fenced value; unmodeled, not zero)
Land and anything outside the fence
Movable contents, outage and business interruption

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the same fenced station, $27,353,236.37 (MISO MTEP24 published table amounts, no extra uplift), applied once

outputs.single_event: conditional: whole-station damage ratio for a stated sub-peril and a depth of 0 to 10 ft; deeper or missing depth returns no value
outputs.scenario_dollars: allowed with the same-station value: damage ratio times $27.35M fenced value, no component terms added
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard computes it only after frequency, missing-mass, station cap and tail checks pass; screening composite, not complete risk or portfolio total

conditions: One canonical 150 x 178 m 345/138 kV station; not an observed asset
Depth at facility grade; no equipment-height shift, area multiplier or protection credit
Coastal is a T4 depth-only transfer; it does not mean the water is fresh
Use the whole assembly once; do not add component curves on top
Cap yearly station loss at its replacement value; keep missing probability mass with a tag

method.summary: FEMA Hazus-MH 2.1 Table 7.9 whole-substation depth-damage ratios used as published (0 to 15% over 0 to 10 ft), the same table already carried by the flood_wind cell

key_sources: FEMA, Hazus-MH 2.1 Flood Technical Manual, Table 7.9 (FW-S011)
flood_wind source register: current Hazus electric-power losses disabled (FW-S012)
Substation flood consumer binding: canonical station and value (SUB-A01)
Owner-selected screening scope and Coastal equal-depth transfer (SUB-A02)
judgment: One canonical 345/138 kV station and its fenced value stand in for any station (SUB-A01)
Coastal water uses the same depth curve with no salt or wave adjustment (SUB-A02)
Civil and site works counted inside the fenced value is an engineering interpretation
open_items: Equipment-local curves and heights deferred to the component research backlog
No qualified response above 10 ft or for coastal salt and wave effects
National completion of Hazard's cloud run still to be verified

rows.variants: sub-peril: pluvial, riverine or coastal (same curve); Hazus class ESSL, ESSM or ESSH (same points)
rows.shape_basis: Hazus Table 7.9 points, linear between them (Coastal use is a T4 transfer)
rows.cost_basis: Hazus loss ratio (T3) applied to a fenced value whose match to the Hazus denominator is T4 (SUB-A01)

notes.text: Same Hazus table as the flood_wind substation assembly (FW_HAZUS_GSU_SUBSTATION_ASSEMBLY)
Coastal uses the river depth curve with no salt or wave effect (T4)
